[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Cunningham was the son of [[Glasgow-2873|Hugh Glasgow]]. He passed away in 1885.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current original-source review, 23 October 2026 ===

'''Father review, 23 October 2026: 83% → 97% confident''' for [[Glasgow-2873|Hugh Glasgow-2873]]. Gibson’s inspected printed p. 414 explicitly calls Cunningham R. Glasgow the congressman Hugh Glasgow’s son and locates his farm about a mile south of the old Glasgow homestead, on the Maryland side of the Mason–Dixon line. The existing Cunningham Ramsay-3742, born 1806, is the adult son of that distinctive name in Hugh’s family. The other Cunningham, Sample-3747, died in infancy and cannot be the mature farmer described. The specific name, recorded father, adult generation and family locality identify the existing pair strongly beyond the earlier memorial/profile reconstruction.

97% is a confident identification of the existing father–child profile pair from an explicit son statement in a late compiled history. It is not a newly discovered birth entry. The book’s present-tense description may reflect information gathered before its 1886 publication; the profile’s retained 1885 death is not corrected to 1886. No mother, exact vital date, parent attachment or live WikiTree flag is changed. [https://ia903202.us.archive.org/BookReader/BookReaderImages.php?zip=/18/items/historyofyorkcou00gibs/historyofyorkcou00gibs_jp2.zip&file=historyofyorkcou00gibs_jp2/historyofyorkcou00gibs_0512.jp2&id=historyofyorkcou00gibs&scale=1&rotate=0 Original printed p. 414].

=== Earlier assessments retained as history ===
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2873]] is assessed at 83% (probable). Hugh Glasgow’s held family reconstruction names Cunningham Ramsay Glasgow, with Find a Grave and the U.S.House biography as sources for the 1769–1818 congressman. Cunningham’s 1806 birth fits the second family; cited obituary images lack transcribed parent wording.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Inspect Hugh’s 1818 estate and the cited family Bible for this child.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/12627890/hugh_glasgow Find A Grave: Hugh Glasgow (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/12627890/hugh_glasgow)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
